summary: 호수, 강 하구, 해안, 초습지, 농경지, 간척지 등에서 볼 수 있는 드문 겨울철새다. 물속에 머리를 넣어 물풀의 잎·줄기·뿌리를 먹고, 때로는 농경지나 풀밭에서도 먹이를 찾는다. 예전에는 전국에 적지 않게 찾아왔으나 지금은 크게 줄어, 강원도 동해안 석호, 낙동강 하구, 태화강, 주남저수지, 금강 하구, 천수만, 삽교호, 한강 등지에서 아주 적은 수가 겨울을 난다. 유라시아 대륙 북부, 알래스카, 캐나다 북부에서 번식하고 유럽 서부, 카스피해 주변, 한국, 중국 동부, 일본에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: small, rounded yellow patch on the bill

similar.how: 큰고니보다 작고, 부리의 노란 부분이 좁고 둥그스름하다.

art.subject: Tundra Swan (Cygnus columbianus), adult in winter (the Bewick's Swan of East Asia): entire plumage white, the head and neck sometimes stained rusty; bill black with a yellow patch at the base that is small, rounded or squarish at its front edge and does not extend forward past the nostril; black lores bordering the yellow; dark eye; black legs and feet.
art.pose: swimming with the head and neck plunged under water, feeding on water plants
art.scene: coastal lagoon on the Korean east coast in winter, shallow open water with marshy edges; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view swimming: all-white plumage, straight upright neck, rounded head, black bill with a small rounded yellow patch at the base
adult, head close-up in profile: black bill with a narrow, rounded yellow patch at the base not reaching beyond the nostril, black lores
first-winter juvenile, side view swimming: grey-brown head, neck and body, bill pinkish-white at the base with a dark tip
art.build: Large swan, 120cm, clearly smaller than Whooper Swan (Cygnus cygnus) and Mute Swan (Cygnus olor), with a shorter, thicker-looking neck held straight and upright, a rounded head and a shorter bill. Sits on the water with the tail level and the wings folded flat. Legs black. Feeds by plunging the head and neck under water. In flight the neck is outstretched.
avoid: Do not paint the yellow as a long wedge reaching past the nostril to a point — that is Whooper Swan (Cygnus cygnus).
Do not paint an orange bill or a black knob (Mute Swan).
Do not curve the neck in an S; the Tundra Swan holds it straight.
Do not paint the juvenile white; it is grey-brown.
